# Remotion Video Creation

Curated by Skill Harbor: a domain-knowledge index for building video programmatically in React with Remotion. The skill points at 29 focused rule files, each covering one production concern: 3D content with Three.js and React Three Fiber, animation fundamentals, asset importing, audio (trimming, volume, speed, pitch), dynamic composition metadata, decode checks with Mediabunny, charts and data visualization, composition and still definitions, TikTok-style captions with word highlighting, SRT import, frame extraction, fonts, GIFs, images, Lottie animations, DOM and text measurement, sequencing, Tailwind styling, text animations, interpolation and easing curves, transcription-to-captions, transitions, trimming, and video embedding. Paste the skill into Muse and ask for the rules relevant to your shot before writing a line of composition code. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: the top-level file is an index, the real detail lives in the rule files, so read the ones you need; you still need a working Remotion project with its dependencies installed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
